comments.body:
If you have good grades and you have a background in engineering, then chances of admissions are very good. 
The nuclear industry in Switzerland has a lot of openings and will have more in the future, since they have to keep running their power plants for the next 20+ years, organize the waste, etc., and many people will be retiring. The master is strongly connected to the local nuclear industry through internships and master theses, therefore many of the students (also non-EU) remain in Switzerland, with jobs at the power plants, electricity companies, NAGRA, consultancy, etc.
comments.author: mr5400
